description: Phrases that were true once and are not any more. The engine fails the build if any survives in tracked text. This list is payload data because what counts as a stale claim is a fact about this design system, not about the engine.

banned.why: single-theme claim — the system ships light + audited dark
false claim — an audited .dark palette IS defined in globals.css
false claim — dark: utilities resolve under .dark (they are not inert)
stale roadmap — dark mode has shipped, it is not "not planned"
graph counts must be read live from graph.json → stats, never hard-coded (they drift)
